checks.name: Report matches its frozen source corpus
Every panel entry has an observable market row
All source timestamps precede entry-day cutoff and satisfy age
Selected documents independently equal latest eligible releases
Saved panel scores match frozen source-score files
Independent exact-calendar BHAR recomputation and missing outcomes
Independent lagged-momentum recomputation excludes entry month
All reported training outcomes matured before forecast cutoff
All models and topic ablations use the same OOS rows
Independent saved-prediction RMSE matches public model metrics
Public market metadata excludes security identifier mapping
Issuer funnel reconciles to fixed target and stage flags
Sector funnel reconciles to overall coverage
Observed OOS and panel issuer flags match saved records
Portfolio calendar gaps cannot silently yield annualized comparisons

scope: Numerical/source-timing checks of saved analysis; does not validate topic semantics, eliminate survivorship bias, or verify rendered artifacts.
